title: State lease (fast loop) (v1)
$comment: Self-contained. Owns ONE request's mutable KV/state on exactly one owner. It DEPENDS on a residency lease (depends_on_residency_lease_id + depends_on_residency_generation); a completion whose epochs mismatch the current values is rejected fail-closed at runtime. Carries the three monotonic identities route_epoch + lease_epoch + seq_slot_epoch. A stateless island reserves zero mutable state (const 0); sticky AND rebuildable each reserve >0 (both if/then), matching WEIGHT_RESIDENCY_CONTRACT section 5 which groups sticky+rebuildable as the reserved_state_bytes>0 case that pins residency. A residency lease going stale (its generation bumped) invalidates every state lease that depends_on the old generation.

in_flight_mutation_seq.description: at most one mutation per state object may be in flight; monotonic

allOf.$comment: stateless islands own no mutable state
sticky state must reserve mutable bytes
rebuildable state also reserves mutable bytes while live (pins residency, per WEIGHT_RESIDENCY_CONTRACT section 5)
